title: Langfens Shared Schema Definitions
description: Reusable $defs shared across all 21 Langfens question type schemas.

id.description: Stable identifier for the option. Must be unique within its question.

idx.description: Zero-based display index of the option.

mediaUrl.description: Optional media (image/audio) attached to this option.

altText.description: Alt text for option media, required when mediaUrl is image-like.

isCorrect.description: Whether this option is marked correct (used by multi-select types).

id.description: Stable identifier for the gap within its question.

normalization.description: Normalization applied to learner input before matching.

wordLimit.description: Maximum number of words allowed in the learner response.

expectedKind.description: Expected semantic kind of the accepted answer.

Gap.description: Payload-side gap descriptor: WHERE the gap is and its constraints. Accepted answers NEVER belong here; they live in the per-type CorrectAnswer definition.

case.description: Case sensitivity policy applied before matching.

collapseInnerWhitespace.description: Collapse runs of internal whitespace to a single space.

stripArticles.description: Strip leading English articles (a, an, the) before matching.

unicode.description: Unicode normalization form applied before matching.

oneOf.description: Apply Canonical Decomposition followed by Canonical Composition.
Apply Compatibility Decomposition followed by Canonical Composition (default).
Do not apply any unicode normalization.

x-enum-descriptions.all-or-nothing: Full credit only if every correct option is selected AND no incorrect option is selected.
x-enum-descriptions.proportional: Partial credit proportional to correct picks (formula varies by type — see per-type description).
x-enum-descriptions.afi: Any Fully-correct Item counts: each correct pair scores independently, no penalty for missing.
x-enum-descriptions.rubric: Human/AI rater applies the supplied rubric.

id.description: Stable identifier for the rubric criterion.

weight.description: Relative weight of this criterion; weights across criteria typically sum to 1.

requiredTokens.description: Tokens that must appear in the learner response.

forbiddenTokens.description: Tokens that must NOT appear in the learner response.

scoringStrategy.description: Algorithm used to score the response against the rubric.

inputControl.description: Recommended frontend input control for this question.

layout.description: Recommended layout for the rendered question.

columns.description: Recommended column count when layout is 'columns' or 'grid'.

mediaPosition.description: Position of the question media relative to the prompt.

estimatedSeconds.description: Author-declared estimate of how long this question takes (seconds).

tags.description: Free-form UI/authoring tags used for filtering or grouping.

UiHints.description: Optional UI rendering hints shared across all question types.

Provenance.description: Sidecar provenance metadata for AI-generated questions.

generatorVersion.description: Version of the generator that emitted this question.

promptHash.description: SHA-256 of the generation prompt in the form `sha256:<64-hex>`.

modelId.description: Model identifier used to generate the question.

reviewStatus.description: Editorial review status of the generated question.

regenerationCount.description: How many times this question was regenerated.

skill.description: Skill band this question belongs to. Every question targets exactly one skill.

oneOf.description: Reading comprehension item — the learner reads text passages and answers questions.
Listening comprehension item — the learner listens to audio and answers questions.

explanationMd.description: Optional author-facing explanation shown after grading.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the question payload schema this document conforms to.

uiHints.description: Optional UI rendering hints for the frontend.

BasePayload.description: Base fields shared by every question payload. Each per-type schema extends this via allOf.
BasePayload.x-generation-hint: Required fields only. provenance is server-side audit metadata; do not display to learners.

BaseQuestion.description: Deprecated alias for BasePayload kept for backward compatibility with existing consumers.

BaseQuestionRef.description: Reference shorthand for the shared BasePayload (formerly BaseQuestion) definition.

OptionRef.description: Reference shorthand for the shared Option definition.

GapRef.description: Reference shorthand for the shared Gap definition.

NormalizationRef.description: Reference shorthand for the shared Normalization definition.

RubricRef.description: Reference shorthand for the shared Rubric definition.

ScoringModeRef.description: Reference shorthand for the shared ScoringMode definition.
